selected: PlxNative shared native UI on a dedicated local branch

candidates.name: PlxNative
candidates.fit: Native UI stack already split into shared crates; card/form/focus/navigation components fit a separate Home app
candidates.decision: Use path dependencies initially; prove independent client before broad framework changes

candidates.name: Glasshouse
candidates.fit: Broad webOS controls and compatibility knowledge, browser frontend
candidates.decision: Use as audited adapter/reference source; do not install full boot/system integration

candidates.name: Custom webOS Home / Lumen / webos-launcher
candidates.fit: Launcher navigation and Home entry patterns; web-rendered frontend
candidates.decision: Design/reference only; renderer does not meet native requirement

candidates.name: ProjectHiten
candidates.decision: No public repository found by exact-name GitHub search; website inaccessible in audit; not a verifiable fork base yet

upstream_policy: Keep the standalone Home app isolated from Plex/player. Generic widgets or build fixes can be proposed separately once independently verified; no publication or maintainer messages in this stage.
initial_host_spike_result: Independent client directly imports plx_ui forms; four host model tests passed. Native rendering/performance of this reused-client build is not yet verified.
current_result: Separate shared-UI native client renders six pages on webOS24/Mali-G52 from a read-only TV snapshot. Scripted focus/OK and injected SDL Back are verified; clean removal passed. No live executor, persistent preferences, physical input or performance claim yet.
